name: ERA5-Land Global Terrestrial Surface Reanalysis
description: ERA5-Land is a global enhanced-resolution replay of the land surface component of the ERA5 atmospheric reanalysis, produced by the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S). Running at an upgraded spatial resolution of 9 km (~0.1 degrees) from 1950 to the present with hourly temporal frequency, ERA5-Land simulates the hydrological and thermodynamic states of the Earth's terrestrial surfaces. Driven by atmospheric forcing from ERA5 with elevation-dependent thermodynamic corrections, it resolves 50 core parameters encompassing soil moisture at four depth layers, snow accumulation, runoff, surface temperature, and turbulent heat fluxes.
